question: Identify an option that does NOT represent prokaryotic cells.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sperm**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sperm **cells are **eukaryotic cells**. They have a **nucleus **inside a specialized region called an acrosome
 
• Prokaryotic cells are primitive cell having three basic structures of typical cells but** lacking nuclear** membranes.
 
• The prokaryotic cell consists of a **single membrane** and therefore, all the reactions occur within the **cytoplasm**
 
• The nucleus is absent in Prokaryotic Cells but nuclear material is present in a region of cytoplasm called the **nucleoid**. 
 
• Membrane-bound organelles are absent in Prokaryotic cells like **Mitochondria**, **lysosomes**, and **Golgi bodies**.
 
• Examples of some Prokaryotic are **viruses**, **bacteria**, **blue-green algae**, **mycoplasma **etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15395601c4a3c3866303d13191a4dedef0576379eda7e7c4453c078f50be6613.png] 

*Fig- Prokaryotic cell*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eukaryotic Cells**

 
 
• **​**These are complete cells which contain membrane-bound organelles and nuclei. Unicellular and multicellular plants and animals have Eukaryotic cells.
 
• The nucleus contains chromatin made up of DNA and histone protein.
 
• The biggest single called organism is Acetabularia.
